summary: syrp-midi (increment 4, final): MIDI 1.0 byte stream <-> UMP conversion. BytesToUmp decodes a byte stream (running status, interleaved real-time bytes, SysEx split into Data 64 packets) without allocating, and UmpPacket::midi1_bytes turns System, MIDI 1.0 Channel Voice and Data 64 packets back into bytes so SysEx reassembles by concatenation.
